name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Stand upright with your feet together and arms at your sides. Jump your feet out to the sides while simultaneously raising your arms overhead.
Jump again to bring your feet back together and your arms back down to your sides, landing softly on the balls of your feet. Repeat at a steady, rhythmic pace.
Jumping jacks are a simple, equipment-free way to raise your heart rate. A 150 lb person will burn about 300 calories doing jumping jacks continuously for 30 minutes.
